verdict.rationale: OpenCode explicitly supports logging in with a GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT Plus/Pro account to use that subscription instead of managing separate API keys, and OpenCode Zen offers free tested models without API key management. Community confirms OpenCode Zen 'almost always has a FREE coding model.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the login-with-account flow itself and clarity on exact free-tier limits/quotas.
